title: Spring Menu Content Planning
scope: Plan content around the new spring menu items — bacon, smoothie, hot dogs

messages.content: Let's plan content around the new spring menu. We've got million dollar bacon, a sunrise smoothie, and loaded hot dogs. I want a blog post and some social coverage.

Great lineup! Here's what I'd recommend:

1. **Million Dollar Bacon** — lead with a blog recipe post. This has viral potential with the name alone. Pair with a hero image from Pixel.
2. **Sunrise Smoothie** — perfect for Instagram. Layered drinks photograph incredibly well. Single image post with recipe in caption.
3. **Loaded Hot Dog** — tie this to the menu review workflow already in progress for task-rv-003.

I'd suggest a two-week rollout: bacon blog first (biggest reach), smoothie social mid-week, then hot dog content tied to the weekend menu launch.

Want me to draft a plan with those channels and timing?
Yes, let's do it. Start bacon blog prep by April 5 and have the smoothie post ready for April 8.

Plan created: **Spring Menu Launch**. I've set up two channels:
- Blog: Million dollar bacon recipe (prep starts Apr 5)
- Instagram: Sunrise smoothie image post (prep starts Apr 6)

Both deliverables are now in the pipeline. You'll get review prompts when drafts are ready.

proposals.title: Spring Menu Launch
proposals.brief: Two-week content rollout for spring menu items: bacon blog, smoothie social, hot dog tie-in.
